title: सुनकोशी-मरिणको ठेक्का रद्दका कागजात पेस गर्न सरकारलाई लेखा समितिको ७ दिने अल्टिमेटम
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । संसदीय समितिले सुनकोशी मरिण डाईभर्सन बहुउद्देश्यीय आयोजनाको ठेक्का रद्दसम्बन्धी सम्पूर्ण कागजात उपलब्ध गराउन सरकारलाई निर्देशन दिएको छ । सिंहदरबारमा मंगलबार बसेको प्रतिनिधिसभा अन्तर्गतको सार्वजनिक लेखा समितिले ठेक्का रद्दसम्बन्धी उजुरीमाथि छलफल गर्दै ७ दिन भित्र सम्पूर्ण कागजात उपलब्ध गराउन निर्देशन दिएको हो । सभापति भरतबहादुर खड्काले राष्ट्रसेवक कर्मचारीहरूलाई विधि, प्रक्रिया र प्रणालीभित्र रहेर काम गर्न आग्रह गर्दै आवश्यक कागजातहरू ७ दिनभित्र समितिमा उपलब्ध गराइदिन निर्देशन दिए । प्रक्रिया, विधि, पद्धति र प्रणाली लोकतन्त्रका आधारभूत नर्म्स भएकाले यसकै आधारमा अघि बढ्नुपर्ने उनको भनाइ थियो । लेखा समिति अन्य निकायजस्तो अख्तियार वा अदालत नभई यसको आफ्नै निश्चित कार्यक्षेत्र रहेकाले सोहीअनुसार स्वाभाविक रूपमा चासो लिइने खड्काले प्रष्ट्याए । बैठकमा जलस्रोत तथा सिंचाइ विभागका महानिर्देशक दिनेश रजौरियाले विभागीय प्रमुखको हैसियतले प्रचलित कानुन र सार्वजनिक खरिदसम्बन्धी व्यवस्थाको पालना सुनिश्चित गर्ने जिम्मेवारीका साथ आफूले ठेक्का प्रक्रिया रद्द गर्ने निर्णय गरेको जिकिर गरे । सार्वजनिक खरिद नियमावली संशोधन अनुसार कागजात र मूल्याङ्कनका आधार सच्याउनुपर्ने देखिएपछि प्रचलित कानुनी अवस्थाको पालना तथा भविष्यमा आउन सक्ने कानुनी र प्रक्रियागत जटिलतालाई दृष्टिगत गरी उक्त बोलपत्र रद्द गर्ने निर्णय गरिएको उनको भनाइ थियो । प्रचलित कानुनी व्यवस्थाविपरीत हुने सम्भावना रहेको खरिद प्रक्रिया अघि बढाउनुको सट्टा कानुनसम्मत, पारदर्शी र प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक खरिद प्रक्रिया सुनिश्चित गर्नु निर्णयको मूल उद्देश्य रहेको रजौरियाले बताए । बैठकमा समिति सदस्यहरुले आर्थिक प्रस्ताव खोल्ने चरणमा ठेक्दा रद्द गर्नुको औचित्यबारे चासो राखेका थिए । कुनै पनि कारणले आयोजना अलपत्र पार्ने काम गर्न नहुने उनीहरूको भनाइ थियो । सांसद मनिष झाले ७ वर्षसम्म परियोजना अन्योलमा रहेको अवस्थामा परियोजना रद्द गरिएमा मधेश आन्दोलनमा उत्रिनुबाहेक अन्य विकल्प नहुने चेतावनी दिए । मधेशमा खेती नै आर्थिक स्रोत रहेकाले त्यसमा खेलबाड वा अल्झाउने काम गर्न नहुने उनको भनाइ थियो । त्यस्तै सांसद खुस्बु ओलीले आर्थिक प्रस्ताव खोल्नुअघि नै बोलपत्र रद्द गर्नुपर्ने तत्कालीन कारणका बारेमा आयोजनाले प्रष्ट पार्नुपर्ने माग गर्नुभयो । आर्थिक प्रस्ताव नखोलिकनै राज्यलाई दुई-तीन अर्ब घाटा हुने दाबीका बारेमा पनि उनले प्रश्न गरिन् । मध्य तराईमा सिँचाइ सुविधा विस्तार र विद्युत् उत्पादन गर्ने लक्ष्यसहित अघि बढाइएको सुनकोशी मरिण डाइभर्सन बहुउद्देश्यीय आयोजनाको बाँध र विद्युत् गृह निर्माणसम्बन्धी ठेक्का रद्द गरिएपछि समितिमा उजुरी परेको थियो । Kathmandu. A parliamentary committee has directed the government to provide all documents related to the cancellation of the contract for the Sunkoshi Marine Diversion Multipurpose Project. The Public Accounts Committee under the House of Representatives, which met at Singha Durbar on Tuesday, discussed the complaint regarding contract cancellation and directed that all documents be provided within 7 days. Chairman Bharat Bahadur Khadka urged civil servants to work within the rules, procedures, and systems and directed them to provide the necessary documents to the committee within 7 days. He said that since the process, method, system and system are the basic norms of democracy, we should move forward on this basis. Khadka clarified that the Audit Committee is not an authority or court like other bodies but has its own specific scope of work, and therefore, it will naturally be taken into consideration accordingly. In the meeting, Dinesh Rajouria, Director General of the Department of Water Resources and Irrigation, asserted that he, as the department head, had decided to cancel the contract process with the responsibility of ensuring compliance with prevailing laws and public procurement regulations. He said that the decision to cancel the bid was made in compliance with the prevailing legal situation and considering possible legal and procedural complications in the future, as it was seen that the documents and evaluation basis needed to be corrected as per the amendments to the Public Procurement Regulations. Rajouria said that the main objective of the decision is to ensure a legal, transparent and competitive procurement process instead of moving forward with a procurement process that is likely to be contrary to the prevailing legal system. In the meeting, the committee members were concerned about the justification for canceling the project at the stage of opening the financial proposal. They said that no work should be done to stall the project for any reason. MP Manish Jha warned that if the project is canceled after the project has been in limbo for 7 years, there will be no other option but to launch a Madhesh movement. He said that since agriculture is the only source of income in Madhesh, there should be no play or entanglement in it. Similarly, MP Khusbu Oli demanded that the project clarify the immediate reasons for canceling the bid before opening the financial proposal. She also questioned the claim that the state would suffer a loss of two to three billion rupees without opening the financial proposal. The committee was notified of the cancellation of the contract for the construction of a dam and power plant for the Sunkoshi Marine Diversion Multipurpose Project, which was launched with the aim of expanding irrigation facilities and generating electricity in the central Terai.

चेतावनी दिए । मधेशमा खेती नै आर्थिक स्रोत रहेकाले त्यसमा खेलबाड वा अल्झाउने काम गर्न नहुने उनको भनाइ थियो । त्यस्तै सांसद खुस्बु ओलीले आर्थिक प्रस्ताव खोल्नुअघि नै बोलपत्र रद्द गर्नुपर्ने तत्कालीन कारणका बारेमा आयोजनाले प्रष्ट पार्नुपर्ने माग गर्नुभयो । आर्थिक प्रस्ताव नखोलिकनै राज्यलाई दुई-तीन अर्ब घाटा हुने दाबीका बारेमा पनि उनले प्रश्न गरिन् । मध्य तराईमा सिँचाइ सुविधा विस्तार र विद्युत् उत्पादन गर्ने लक्ष्यसहित अघि बढाइएको सुनकोशी मरिण डाइभर्सन बहुउद्देश्यीय आयोजनाको बाँध र विद्युत् गृह निर्माणसम्बन्धी ठेक्का रद्द गरिएपछि समितिमा उजुरी परेको थियो । Kathmandu. A parliamentary committee has directed the government to provide all documents related to the cancellation of the contract for the Sunkoshi Marine Diversion Multipurpose Project. The Public Accounts Committee under the House of Representatives, which met at Singha Durbar on Tuesday, discussed the complaint regarding contract cancellation and directed that all documents be provided within 7 days. Chairman Bharat Bahadur Khadka urged civil servants to work within the rules, procedures, and systems and directed them to provide the necessary documents to the committee within 7 days. He said that since the process, method, system and system are the basic norms of democracy, we should move forward on this basis. Khadka clarified that the Audit Committee is not an authority or court like other bodies but has its own specific scope of work, and therefore, it will naturally be taken into consideration accordingly. In the meeting, Dinesh Rajouria, Director General of the Department of Water Resources and Irrigation, asserted that he, as the department head, had decided to cancel the contract process with the responsibility of ensuring compliance with prevailing laws and public procurement regulations. He said that the decision to cancel the bid was made in compliance with the prevailing legal situation and considering possible legal and procedural complications in the future, as it was seen that the documents and evaluation basis needed to be corrected as per the amendments to the Public Procurement Regulations. Rajouria said that the main objective of the decision is to ensure a legal, transparent and competitive procurement process instead of moving forward with a procurement process that is likely to be contrary to the prevailing legal system. In the meeting, the committee members were concerned about the justification for canceling the project at the stage of opening the financial proposal. They said that no work should be done to stall the project for any reason. MP Manish Jha warned that if the project is canceled after the project has been in limbo for 7 years, there will be no other option but to launch a Madhesh movement. He said that since agriculture is the only source of income in Madhesh, there should be no play or entanglement in it. Similarly, MP Khusbu Oli demanded that the project clarify the immediate reasons for canceling the bid before opening the financial proposal. She also questioned the claim that the state would suffer a loss of two to three billion rupees without opening the financial proposal. The committee was notified of the cancellation of the contract for the construction of a dam and power plant for the Sunkoshi Marine Diversion Multipurpose Project, which was launched with the aim of expanding irrigation facilities and generating electricity in the central Terai.

बसेको प्रतिनिधिसभा अन्तर्गतको सार्वजनिक लेखा समितिले ठेक्का रद्दसम्बन्धी उजुरीमाथि छलफल गर्दै ७ दिन भित्र सम्पूर्ण कागजात उपलब्ध गराउन निर्देशन दिएको हो । सभापति भरतबहादुर खड्काले राष्ट्रसेवक कर्मचारीहरूलाई विधि, प्रक्रिया र प्रणालीभित्र रहेर काम गर्न आग्रह गर्दै आवश्यक कागजातहरू ७ दिनभित्र समितिमा उपलब्ध गराइदिन निर्देशन दिए । प्रक्रिया, विधि, पद्धति र प्रणाली लोकतन्त्रका आधारभूत नर्म्स भएकाले यसकै आधारमा अघि बढ्नुपर्ने उनको भनाइ थियो । लेखा समिति अन्य निकायजस्तो अख्तियार वा अदालत नभई यसको आफ्नै निश्चित कार्यक्षेत्र रहेकाले सोहीअनुसार स्वाभाविक रूपमा चासो लिइने खड्काले प्रष्ट्याए । प्रणालीभित्र रहेर काम गर्न आग्रह गर्दै आवश्यक कागजातहरू ७ दिनभित्र समितिमा उपलब्ध गराइदिन निर्देशन दिए । प्रक्रिया, विधि, पद्धति र प्रणाली लोकतन्त्रका आधारभूत नर्म्स भएकाले यसकै आधारमा अघि बढ्नुपर्ने उनको भनाइ थियो । लेखा समिति अन्य निकायजस्तो अख्तियार वा अदालत नभई यसको आफ्नै निश्चित कार्यक्षेत्र रहेकाले सोहीअनुसार स्वाभाविक रूपमा चासो लिइने खड्काले प्रष्ट्याए । बैठकमा जलस्रोत तथा सिंचाइ विभागका महानिर्देशक दिनेश रजौरियाले विभागीय प्रमुखको हैसियतले प्रचलित कानुन र सार्वजनिक खरिदसम्बन्धी व्यवस्थाको पालना सुनिश्चित गर्ने जिम्मेवारीका साथ आफूले ठेक्का प्रक्रिया रद्द गर्ने निर्णय गरेको जिकिर गरे । सार्वजनिक खरिद नियमावली संशोधन अनुसार कागजात र मूल्याङ्कनका आधार सच्याउनुपर्ने देखिएपछि प्रचलित कानुनी अवस्थाको पालना तथा भविष्यमा आउन सक्ने कानुनी र प्रक्रियागत जटिलतालाई दृष्टिगत गरी उक्त बोलपत्र रद्द गर्ने निर्णय गरिएको उनको भनाइ थियो । प्रचलित कानुनी व्यवस्थाविपरीत हुने सम्भावना रहेको खरिद प्रक्रिया अघि बढाउनुको सट्टा कानुनसम्मत, पारदर्शी र प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक खरिद प्रक्रिया सुनिश्चित गर्नु निर्णयको मूल उद्देश्य रहेको रजौरियाले बताए । बैठकमा समिति सदस्यहरुले आर्थिक प्रस्ताव खोल्ने चरणमा ठेक्दा रद्द गर्नुको औचित्यबारे चासो राखेका थिए । कुनै पनि कारणले आयोजना अलपत्र पार्ने काम गर्न नहुने उनीहरूको भनाइ थियो । सांसद मनिष झाले ७ वर्षसम्म परियोजना अन्योलमा रहेको अवस्थामा परियोजना रद्द गरिएमा मधेश आन्दोलनमा उत्रिनुबाहेक अन्य विकल्प नहुने चेतावनी दिए । मधेशमा खेती नै आर्थिक स्रोत रहेकाले त्यसमा खेलबाड वा अल्झाउने काम गर्न नहुने उनको भनाइ थियो । त्यस्तै सांसद खुस्बु ओलीले आर्थिक प्रस्ताव खोल्नुअघि नै बोलपत्र रद्द गर्नुपर्ने तत्कालीन कारणका बारेमा आयोजनाले प्रष्ट पार्नुपर्ने माग गर्नुभयो । आर्थिक प्रस्ताव नखोलिकनै राज्यलाई दुई-तीन अर्ब घाटा हुने दाबीका बारेमा पनि उनले प्रश्न गरिन् । मध्य तराईमा सिँचाइ सुविधा विस्तार र विद्युत् उत्पादन गर्ने लक्ष्यसहित अघि बढाइएको सुनकोशी मरिण डाइभर्सन बहुउद्देश्यीय आयोजनाको बाँध र विद्युत् गृह निर्माणसम्बन्धी ठेक्का रद्द गरिएपछि समितिमा उजुरी परेको थियो ।

Kathmandu. A parliamentary committee has directed the government to provide all documents related to the cancellation of the contract for the Sunkoshi Marine Diversion Multipurpose Project. The Public Accounts Committee under the House of Representatives, which met at Singha Durbar on Tuesday, discussed the complaint regarding contract cancellation and directed that all documents be provided within 7 days. Chairman Bharat Bahadur Khadka urged civil servants to work within the rules, procedures, and systems and directed them to provide the necessary documents to the committee within 7 days. He said that since the process, method, system and system are the basic norms of democracy, we should move forward on this basis. Khadka clarified that the Audit Committee is not an authority or court like other bodies but has its own specific scope of work, and therefore, it will naturally be taken into consideration accordingly. In the meeting, Dinesh Rajouria, Director General of the Department of Water Resources and Irrigation, asserted that he, as the department head, had decided to cancel the contract process with the responsibility of ensuring compliance with prevailing laws and public procurement regulations. He said that the decision to cancel the bid was made in compliance with the prevailing legal situation and considering possible legal and procedural complications in the future, as it was seen that the documents and evaluation basis needed to be corrected as per the amendments to the Public Procurement Regulations. Rajouria said that the main objective of the decision is to ensure a legal, transparent and competitive procurement process instead of moving forward with a procurement process that is likely to be contrary to the prevailing legal system. In the meeting, the committee members were concerned about the justification for canceling the project at the stage of opening the financial proposal. They said that no work should be done to stall the project for any reason. MP Manish Jha warned that if the project is canceled after the project has been in limbo for 7 years, there will be no other option but to launch a Madhesh movement. He said that since agriculture is the only source of income in Madhesh, there should be no play or entanglement in it. Similarly, MP Khusbu Oli demanded that the project clarify the immediate reasons for canceling the bid before opening the financial proposal. She also questioned the claim that the state would suffer a loss of two to three billion rupees without opening the financial proposal. The committee was notified of the cancellation of the contract for the construction of a dam and power plant for the Sunkoshi Marine Diversion Multipurpose Project, which was launched with the aim of expanding irrigation facilities and generating electricity in the central Terai.
